S0 / S1 / S3 题目级配对翻转分析
Question-level paired flip analysis

作者 / Author: spinner-bot · 正式作业 / Formal run: 60011513

同一道视觉选择题在三种输入条件下，什么时候从错变对，什么时候从对变错？For the same visual multiple-choice question, when does a prompt turn an incorrect answer into a correct one, and when does it reverse a correct answer?

目录 / Contents
  1. 摘要 / Summary
  2. 八种状态 / Eight states
  3. 逻辑合并 / Logical groups
  4. 任务构成 / Task composition
  5. 任务内部概率 / Within-task rates
  6. 长度与翻转 / Length and flips
  7. 原始回答案例 / Raw-response cases
  8. 研究判断 / Interpretation

摘要 / Summary

346/768
至少一种提示修正 S0 错题
Baseline errors recovered by S1 or S3 · 45.1%
80/1232
至少一种提示损失 S0 对题
Baseline correct answers lost by S1 or S3 · 6.5%
214/346
被修正题目中两提示共同修正
Both prompts recover among any recovered · 61.8%

总体收益的结构：S1 有 298 次修正、45 次损失，净增加 253 题；S3 有 262 次修正、61 次损失，净增加 201 题。相对 2000 题分别提高 12.65 和 10.05 个百分点。S1 recovers 298 baseline errors and loses 45 correct answers, for a net gain of 253 questions. S3 recovers 262 and loses 61, for a net gain of 201. These correspond to +12.65 and +10.05 percentage points over 2,000 questions.

这批样本中，S1 与 S3 的正确性结果不同的题目有 186 题（9.3%）。因此两种提示不能仅用相近的总体准确率代替逐题比较。S1 and S3 disagree in correctness on 186 questions (9.3%). Similar aggregate accuracy does not capture where the two prompts behave differently.

一、八种互斥状态 / I. Eight mutually exclusive states

按 S0、S1、S3 的顺序，以 1 表示答对、0 表示答错。例如 011 表示 S0 错、S1 和 S3 均对。八组恰好分割全部 2000 题。The three digits follow S0, S1, S3; 1 means correct and 0 means incorrect. For example, 011 means S0 is wrong while both S1 and S3 are correct. The eight groups partition all 2,000 questions.

  • 000 · 始终错误 / all wrong：422 / 2000 (21.1%)
  • 001 · 仅 S3 修正 / S3 only recovers：48 / 2000 (2.4%)
  • 010 · 仅 S1 修正 / S1 only recovers：84 / 2000 (4.2%)
  • 011 · 共同修正 / both recover：214 / 2000 (10.7%)
  • 100 · 共同损失 / both lose：26 / 2000 (1.3%)
  • 101 · 仅 S1 损失 / S1 only loses：19 / 2000 (0.9%)
  • 110 · 仅 S3 损失 / S3 only loses：35 / 2000 (1.8%)
  • 111 · 始终正确 / all correct：1152 / 2000 (57.6%)

最值得研究的是 011（共同修正，214 题）与 100（共同损失，26 题），因为两种提示在这些题目上给出同向翻转；001、010、101、110 则直接暴露两种提示的差异。The 011 group (214 jointly recovered questions) and 100 group (26 jointly lost questions) show same-direction flips under both prompts. The 001, 010, 101, and 110 groups reveal their differences.

二、按基线状态合并 / II. Logical groups by baseline state

S0 原本答错 768 题：至少一种提示修正 346 题（45.1%），其中两者共同修正 214 题（占 S0 错题 27.9%）。另有 422 题三组均错。S0 is wrong on 768 questions. At least one prompt recovers 346 (45.1%), and both recover 214 (27.9% of S0 errors). All three remain wrong on 422 questions.

S0 原本答对 1232 题：至少一种提示造成损失 80 题（6.5%），其中两者共同损失 26 题（占 S0 对题 2.1%）。另有 1152 题三组均对。S0 is correct on 1232 questions. At least one prompt loses 80 (6.5%), and both lose 26 (2.1% of S0 correct answers). All three are correct on 1152 questions.

以上“至少一种提示”的联合数字描述潜在可恢复题目的覆盖范围，不能当作一个预先固定提示的部署准确率，因为事先不知道每题应选 S1 还是 S3。The “at least one prompt” counts describe the coverage of potentially recoverable questions. They are not the accuracy of a deployable fixed-prompt system: choosing S1 or S3 for each question in advance is unresolved.

三、翻转组内部是什么任务 / III. Task composition inside flip groups

下面四个环形图分别问：在 S1 修正、S1 损失、S3 修正、S3 损失的题目内部，Count、Depth、Distance、Relation 各占多少。每个环的分母都是该翻转组自己的题目数。The four donuts show the mix of Count, Depth, Distance, and Relation within S1 gains, S1 losses, S3 gains, and S3 losses. Each donut uses its own flip-group total as denominator.

Distance 和 Depth 在修正组中有较多样本，但它们本来就在总体数据中占较大比例。仅凭组内占比，不能断言这两类题目更容易被提示修正；需要看同类题目中的翻转率。Distance and Depth contribute many recovered questions, but they also make up a large share of the full dataset. Within-group composition alone cannot show whether prompts are more likely to recover these tasks; that requires within-task rates.

四、各任务自身的翻转概率 / IV. Flip rates within each task

修正率以“该任务中 S0 原本答错的题目”为分母；损失率以“该任务中 S0 原本答对的题目”为分母。这样可以区分样本量效应与任务特异行为。Recovery rates use baseline-wrong questions within each task as denominator; loss rates use baseline-correct questions within that task. This separates task prevalence from task-specific behavior.

  • Count：424 题；S0 错题 306 中至少一个条件修正 21（6.9%）；S0 对题 118 中至少一个条件损失 11（9.3%）。Count: 424 questions; 21/306 baseline errors recovered by at least one condition (6.9%); 11/118 baseline correct answers lost by at least one condition (9.3%).
  • Depth：515 题；S0 错题 119 中至少一个条件修正 90（75.6%）；S0 对题 396 中至少一个条件损失 19（4.8%）。Depth: 515 questions; 90/119 baseline errors recovered by at least one condition (75.6%); 19/396 baseline correct answers lost by at least one condition (4.8%).
  • Distance：516 题；S0 错题 224 中至少一个条件修正 138（61.6%）；S0 对题 292 中至少一个条件损失 42（14.4%）。Distance: 516 questions; 138/224 baseline errors recovered by at least one condition (61.6%); 42/292 baseline correct answers lost by at least one condition (14.4%).
  • Relation：545 题；S0 错题 119 中至少一个条件修正 97（81.5%）；S0 对题 426 中至少一个条件损失 8（1.9%）。Relation: 545 questions; 97/119 baseline errors recovered by at least one condition (81.5%); 8/426 baseline correct answers lost by at least one condition (1.9%).

最突出的差异是：Count 的 S0 错题仅 21/306（6.9%）被至少一种提示修正；Relation 为 97/119（81.5%），Depth 为 90/119（75.6%），Distance 为 138/224（61.6%）。另一方面，Distance 的 S0 对题有 42/292（14.4%）在至少一种提示下损失，Relation 只有 8/426（1.9%）。这些值都是同类任务内部的条件比例。The largest contrast is that only 21/306 baseline-wrong Count questions (6.9%) are recovered by either prompt, versus 97/119 Relation (81.5%), 90/119 Depth (75.6%), and 138/224 Distance (61.6%). Among baseline-correct questions, at least one prompt loses 42/292 Distance questions (14.4%) but only 8/426 Relation questions (1.9%). These are conditional rates within each task.

这些任务层数字用于定位值得检查的题目簇。任务、图像来源与 2D/3D 划分并非独立分配，本轮无法将任务效应与数据来源效应分离；这些细分差异属于探索性发现。These task-level figures locate question clusters worth inspecting. Task, image source, and 2D/3D split were not independently assigned, so this run cannot separate task effects from source effects; subgroup differences remain exploratory.

五、长度变化是否解释翻转 / V. Does length explain the flips?

按八种状态比较三条件的输出 token 中位数。S1 和 S3 通常比 S0 更短；但“共同修正”和“共同损失”都存在于短输出条件下，因此长度压缩本身无法解释翻转方向。Median completion tokens are shown for all eight states. S1 and S3 are usually shorter than S0, yet both joint recovery and joint loss occur under these shorter-output conditions. Compression alone does not determine flip direction.

在 S1 的修正题与损失题中，相对 S0 的平均长度变化分别约为 −77.4 与 −77.1 tokens；两类几乎相同。S3 的对应变化约为 −85.5 与 −57.3 tokens。后者提示值得继续检查输出内容与题目属性，但仍不能作为因果结论。For S1, mean changes from S0 are about −77.4 tokens for gains and −77.1 for losses, nearly identical. For S3, the corresponding changes are about −85.5 and −57.3 tokens. The latter invites closer inspection of responses and task properties, but remains an association.

六、题目级原始回答 / VI. Question-level raw responses

每个翻转状态选取一个大幅缩短输出的案例和一个接近该状态典型长度变化的案例，共 12 个。每个案例给出题目、选项、标准答案、三条件正确性、token 数及完整原始输出。点击条目展开。Each flip state contributes one large-reduction case and one case near its median length change, for 12 cases total. Each includes the question, choices, gold answer, correctness, token counts, and complete raw responses under all three conditions. Open a case to inspect it.

案例 03 / Case 03 · 010 仅 S1 修正 / S1 only recovers · Distance · S0/S1/S3 ✗ / ✓ / ✗ · tokens 498 → 62 → 76

问题 / Question: Estimate the real-world distances between objects in this image. Which object is closer to the shelves (highlighted by a red box), the books (highlighted by a blue box) or the lamp (highlighted by a green box)?

  1. (A) books
  2. (B) lamp

标准答案 / Gold: B

长度变化 / Token change: S1−S0 -436; S3−S0 -422. 该状态中按最大长度缩减选取。Selection: largest reduction within this state.

S0 · 错误 / Incorrect · 498 tokens

解析选项 / Parsed option: A

The image shows a scene with multiple objects, including:

- **Books** (in the blue box) — located in the foreground, on a table or surface near the bottom left.
- **Lamp** (in the green box) — hanging from the ceiling, positioned more toward the center and upper part of the image.
- **Shelves** (in the red box) — mounted on the wall in the background, to the right side of the image.

We are to determine which object — the books or the lamp — is **closer to the shelves**.

Looking at spatial relationships:

- The **shelves** are on the right wall, mid-to-background depth.
- The **lamp** is hanging above the dining area, roughly aligned with the middle of the image horizontally and vertically — it appears to be at a similar depth as the shelves, perhaps slightly in front.
- The **books** are in the immediate foreground, very close to the camera, but they are on the left side of the image.

However, we must consider **horizontal and vertical proximity**, not just depth.

Visually:

- The **lamp** is positioned more directly above and slightly to the left of the shelves. Its horizontal position is closer to the shelves than the books are.
- The **books** are far to the left and in the foreground — while they may be closer in depth (z-axis), their lateral (x-axis) distance to the shelves is large.

But the question asks: **“Which object is closer to the shelves?”**

In 3D space, “closer” usually means shortest Euclidean distance between the two objects.

Let’s estimate:

- Distance from **lamp to shelves**: The lamp is hanging near the center-top; the shelves are on the right wall. The lamp is roughly 2–3 meters away horizontally and maybe 1–2 meters vertically — total distance ~3–4 meters.
- Distance from **books to shelves**: The books are in the bottom-left foreground. The shelves are on the right wall, mid-height. This is a large diagonal distance — likely 5+ meters.

Even though the books are in the foreground, their position on the far left makes them much farther from the shelves than the lamp is.

Therefore, the **lamp** is closer to the shelves.

✅ Correct answer: **(B) lamp**

S1 · 正确 / Correct · 62 tokens

解析选项 / Parsed option: B

The lamp (green box) is closer to the shelves (red box) than the books (blue box). The books are in the foreground, but the lamp is positioned between the viewer and the shelves, making it physically nearer to the shelves in the scene’s layout.

Answer: (B) lamp

S3 · 错误 / Incorrect · 76 tokens

解析选项 / Parsed option: A

The image shows a scene with a lamp (green box) and books (blue box), both positioned in front of shelves (red box). The lamp is visibly closer to the shelves than the books, as it appears larger and more detailed, indicating proximity. The books are further back in the scene.

Therefore, the lamp is closer to the shelves.

(B) lamp

七、研究判断与边界 / VII. Interpretation and next questions

题目级结果比总体准确率多揭示两件事：一是两种提示共同修正了大量 S0 错题；二是它们也存在共同损失和彼此不一致的题目。后续最值得做的是人工审阅 011、100 和四类单条件翻转，归纳可观察的错误模式，再用独立样本检验这些模式。Question-level results add two findings beyond aggregate accuracy: the prompts jointly recover many baseline errors, and they also share losses and disagree on some questions. The next useful step is to review 011, 100, and the four single-prompt flip states, define observable error patterns, and test those patterns on independent samples.
